text:
Anita: quick sync on the pin/rollout metadata follow-up. i want to surface two new concepts: pin_affinity (runtime hint for placement) vs pin_intent (policy for eviction), and an eviction_score that determines when soft pins are eligible for replacement. thoughts?
Devon: sounds helpful. pin_affinity can be a preference list for allocator, pin_intent drives eviction policy. eviction_score needs a clear formula or we'll get surprises.
Priya: propose eviction_score = age_ms/grace_window_ms + pressure_factor. keep it deterministic and cheap to compute.
Marco: we should also add a safety_label enum: [customer-critical, internal-test, ephemeral] so ops can suppress evictions during incidents.
Anita: agreed on safety_label. we also need a bounded telemetry_tags mechanism so teams can't explode metric cardinality. allow per-tenant tag keys and restrict values to short tokens, maybe max 3 tags. enforce in ingestion.
Devon: on model identity: fingerprint alone is brittle across fine-tuning. suggest fingerprint + compatibility_group (semantic id) so fallback prefers same compatibility_group and only uses fingerprint to detect exact mismatch.
Priya: example schema sketch: 
```
{
  "pin_hint": "release/2026-03/blue",
  "pin_affinity": ["rack:A","region:us-east-1"],
  "pin_intent": "soft",
  "grace_window_ms": "600000",
  "eviction_score": "computed",
  "safety_label": "customer-critical",
  "telemetry_tags": ["cohort:alpha","stage:preprod"],
  "compatibility_group": "gpt-small-v2",
  "model_fingerprint": "sha256:abcd1234",
  "fallback_order": ["variant-v2-q4","variant-v2-fp16"],
  "lease_token": "internal-only"
}
```
Marco: minor caveat: clients should never see lease_token. split public/internal fields and document which are read-only.
Anita: good point. public surface: pin_hint, pin_affinity, pin_intent, grace_window_ms, telemetry_tags, fallback_order, compatibility_group, model_fingerprint (prefix). internal: lease_token, last_renewed_ms, eviction_score.
Devon: migration plan: 1) server reads both old and new fields for ~3 weeks, 2) backfill compatibility_group for existing pins using model metadata, 3) write new pins with both representations in a migration window.
Priya: backfill job needs a safety mode to skip pins with safety_label=customer-critical. Marcos ops should approve list.
Marco: will provide ops whitelist. also want alerting if backfill fails on >0.5% of pins.
infra-bot: created INF-2981: pin-metadata-backfill (https://phabricator.redwood/INF-2981) :white_check_mark:
Anita: runtime: allocator should treat pin_affinity as soft hints unless pin_intent=hard. fallback_order is authoritative for model selection; if fingerprint mismatch beyond prefix length, skip variant.
Devon: fingerprint prefix length: 8 hex chars seems reasonable to avoid tiny collisions but still stable. document expectation.
Priya: telemetry: record pin_transition events with fields: tenant, route, pin_intent, safety_label, and bounded telemetry_tags. ensure no PII.
Marco: ops: reserve a 2-hour window for migration and a canary group of 5 tenants. rollback plan: reapply old pins from snapshot and abort backfill job.
release-bot: scheduled canary-release: pin-schema-migration v1 -> canary tenants (5) on Tue 03:00 UTC
Anita: action items: Devon draft schema PR with public/internal split + compatibility_group + safety_label; Priya draft eviction_score formula and unit tests; Marco coordinate ops whitelist and migration window; infra team to implement telemetry tag allowlist enforcement.
Devon: i'll include compatibility fallback pseudocode and a compatibility check endpoint for clients.
Priya: i'll put eviction_score sim scripts in the PR so reviewers can sanity-check thresholds.
Marco: i'll stub the playbook and post it to the migration ticket.
Anita: ok great. keep pin_affinity as best-effort hint; pin_intent semantics in docs: hard = no eviction, soft = eligible after grace_window_ms and eviction_score threshold, staging = prefer staging pool, canary = route small traffic slices.
Devon: will add examples showing how fallback_order interacts with compatibility_group.
Anita: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a short RFC update and link INF-2981.
infra-bot: linked INF-2981 -> DEPLOY-202 for rollout coordination.
